children: Domestic markets are likely to open on flat to negative note on Friday, on crucial results day. India’s top most valued companies — Reliance Industries and the recently-listed Jio Platforms — will announce their quarterly numbers that are most likely after market hours.
However, global cues are weak, with Nasdaq plunging 365 points, dragged by Google’s Alphabet.
Gift Nifty is hovering around 23,000 in early deal on Friday, signally flat-to-negative opening, even as Asian stocks are down sharply lower.

title: Negative bias seen amid global headwinds
